title: Build a 3D product website with an agent using Blender
summary: A web designer had Claude Code install Blender, model a paperclip and render every frame for a concept site; he says it took 5 hours with no hand edits.
agent_role: Claude Code installed Blender on its cloud server, built the 3D paperclip model, rendered every frame and built the site. The human picked design inspiration and asked for a few rounds of revisions.
outcome: Author reports building the finished concept site in 5 hours, with all assets generated by Claude.
what_they_did: A web designer picked an award-winning site as inspiration for a fictional AI lab's product page. He asked Claude Code to install Blender, a free 3D design program, on its cloud machine. Claude then modeled a paperclip, rendered every animation frame and built the site. He guided it through a few rounds of revisions.
how_it_went: He says the site took 5 hours and everything in it was made by Claude, with no hand work. The finished concept site is live.
worth_knowing: The 3D work only happened because the agent could install and run Blender itself on a cloud machine. The site needs JavaScript to show its films and 3D.
prompt: Install Blender on your machine. Then model a simple 3D object: [object, e.g. a paperclip]. Animate it [describe the motion] and render every frame. Use the frames to build a one-page product website for [product or brand], inspired by the style of [example site]. Show me sample renders and a draft of the page before finishing, and wait for my feedback on each revision.

curation.rationale: A real multi-step use: Claude Code installed Blender on its cloud machine, modeled and rendered a 3D paperclip, and built a concept site with a live demo. Details are thin, and the post ends with a sales pitch.
